schema_notes: Each atom = one clinical concept, captured from every angle EHR data actually uses it: clinical names, abbreviations, misspellings, and every code system (ICD-10, ICD-9, SNOMED, CPT, HCPCS). Every code carries match_role: best (strongest single code) | related (weaker but still positive) | differential (looks similar, must NOT count as a match — kept here so it's documented, not silently re-added later). Matching SQL uses: keywords on text columns; active ICD-10/ICD-9 on claim diagnosis columns; active CPT/HCPCS on claim procedure columns; active SNOMED on medical/surgical/family history SNOMED columns (best/related). Names/abbreviations are documentation.
